MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.35 + Hand Landmarker model (float16, version 1)
===========================================================================
Used by the webcam air wheel (js/input/camwheel-hands.js) to find the player's hands in the webcam picture.
Loaded only when the player switches the webcam wheel on; everything runs in the browser (WebAssembly + WebGL),
no frame ever leaves the device.

Project: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe   https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker

npm tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/-/tasks-vision-0.10.35.tgz
  integrity sha512-HOvadwVRE6JC+45nyYhmnywnr5h/J8KZvOeUNVOG9q/0875pZgItznFB9bRTvLc264YSJqiZ1NsIpCStJw/egg== (verified)
The package has no install scripts; nothing was run. The files are unmodified. Only the SIMD wasm build is shipped
(every current browser supports WebAssembly SIMD); the no-SIMD and module variants and the source maps are left out.
To update: download a newer tarball + model, verify, put them in vendor/mediapipe/tasks-vision-<version>/ and change
VENDOR in js/input/camwheel-hands.js.
